description: Set how much the Nock Agent does alone for one action type in this workspace: 1 only tells (default), 2 suggests and does it with one tap, 3 does it and tells after. Whatever the level, the Agent still waits for approval before spending above a routine's credit cap, deleting, messaging leads with a cadence nobody approved, or touching billing. Only for an explicit request naming the change; never raise it from a complaint or a vague request. Raising takes two calls: with confirmed false it saves nothing and returns a quote ("Vou deixar X no nível N: ... Confirma?"); with confirmed true, only after the user's explicit yes to that quote, it saves. Lowering saves at once.

confirmed.description: Raising only: false (or absent) to get the quote; true only after the user said yes to it.

name: set_autonomy_level
title: Definir autonomia do Nock Agent
